children: A student-run anime & games convention at Carnegie Mellon University.

Welcome to our seventh year of ScottyCon! We hope you enjoy CMU's one and only (and therefore best) anime and video gaming convention! We'll have a blast of events this year, ranging from panels, masquerade, artist alley, and much more.
We update this site on a rolling basis. Check back in March for our full event schedule! Meanwhile, view the "Info" tab for more details about our event.
Never miss an update on applications, ticket sales, merch preorders, and more!

🔸Special Guest Event: Panel Discussion & MV Showcase 🔸

Join us for our special guest panel featuring Sheeno Mirin and StudioGnu! In this panel, they will discuss interdisciplinary approaches to music and technology, as well as insights into Vocaloid culture from a creator’s perspective.

We will also be hosting a music video showcase highlighting the works of Sheeno Mirin and StudioGnu, beginning 15 minutes before the panel!
